item.title: Version 2.1.1
item.description:
New

  • Edit photos in Debut — open the screenshot editor directly from the dashboard ("Edit Image" in the dropdown and Quick Start), import any image file at its native resolution, or start from a drag-and-drop / click-to-pick drop zone with no capture required.
  • Drag-and-drop import on the dashboard — drop a video or photo anywhere on the dashboard to import it; videos go straight into the editor, and dropped photos open a chooser to send them to the Photo Editor or Video Editor.
  • Output aspect-ratio control for screenshots — pick 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16, or 21:9 for screenshot exports right in the inspector's Shape section.

Improved

  • Redesigned export dialog — the multi-step sidebar is now a single editable page (Format → Quality → Frame Rate), with the legacy H.264 codec tucked behind an Advanced disclosure.
  • Accurate export size estimates — replaced the flat duration-based guess with a real bitrate model that accounts for resolution, frame rate, and codec.
  • Correct resolution labels — quality cards and the dialog header now show the true output dimensions derived from your canvas instead of hardcoded "4K"/"1080p" labels.
  • Faster, smoother imports — file copies now run off the main thread, so importing a video no longer freezes the dashboard, and imported videos open straight in the editor.

Fixed

  • Hid the ProRes export option, which silently fell back to H.264 (tracked in DEBUT-324).
  • Removed misleading "1080p / 720p / 480p" text from export quality descriptions.
